title: Phase Three: Talking About Anything Else (continued)

body: This is the heart of the engagement. In this phase you will learn how a question works, find some topics that are not padel, agree a daily padel budget and practise listening, which is like waiting for the ball to come off the glass, only the ball is another person and you are not allowed to hit it.
Your stakeholders have high hopes for this phase. Please don't bring up the fact that the engagement just used a padel metaphor. We noticed.
